prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Egyptian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, an iron cube-shaped block, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop with a heavy rough silver a barrel-shaped weight hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum anklets. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Lebanese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome male model face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, a firm jaw and straight dark brows, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth olive-tan skin, a gentle soft smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a bronze ship's anchor, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
